review.scope: Finite source-to-consumer audit of lives, ordinary work/materials, livelihoods, independent residents, teaching and social/family continuity. Current dirty checkout is the source of truth; HEAD alone is insufficient.
review.source_identity: Relevant implementation files were compared with missing-feature-audit/INPUT_SNAPSHOT.json and matched at review. Review is static; no test, build, browser, save, external source or private save was run/read.
review.delivery_state: The current project records these recently added gameplay families as built but implemented-unverified. This appendix establishes source declarations, registry/UI/save seams, not executed play or director acceptance.
review.scope_boundary: Preserve the vanilla opening and first one-realm/one-prestige milestone. Broad ecology, household, institution, lifespan and career mechanics are conditional on a selected world needing them; they are not universal prerequisites.

summary.interpretation: These counts classify this bounded lives/work/society coverage, not all USER_VISION families or completed gameplay. Unknowns below are explicit, not inferred absences.

unknowns: This appendix samples the native gathering/drop and connected craft/use owners; it is not an exhaustive audit of every recipe, consumable, trader or legacy action.
It inspects the current simulation controller, field/craftsman/Glasshouse cases and selected UI bindings; other native dialogue/NPC roles were not exhaustively mapped.
It does not complete the broader campaign/world roster or determine which future setting actually needs lineage, institutional law, aging or autonomous professions.
No browser, generated-save, save/reload, failure, gameplay, or director acceptance was performed here; current behavior remains at the recorded implemented-unverified gate.

coverage.actual_gap_or_no_gap: Gathering, job reservations, crafting, and inventory are present. The additional selected-world gap is a single supported chain from finite regional stock/producer through harvest method, condition-preserving material, refinement/repair and a named resident demand/output. Current native gathering uses Math.random at settlement and has no inspected regional stock publication; do not claim an existing deterministic finite-node join.
coverage.selected_vs_optional_need: The user requested fuller ordinary and technical progression. Finite ecology and lot conservation are required only for worlds whose selected resources are finite, renewable, seasonal or uniquely owned; source-supported inexhaustible resources remain so. No universal ecology simulation is selected.

candidate_packet_seam.example: A resident asks for sound willow strips for a repairable field gauge. The player can cut a declared amount from one known bank, tend it for later supply, buy an existing batch, accept funded measuring work, or refuse. A successful cut changes that node's available stock and carries actual material into repair; a failed/wet batch records what was lost without producing a gauge.
candidate_packet_seam.reuse: Regions owns node and renewal rules; Items owns exact material/portion and transformation; existing native gathering/crafting stay the player-facing entry points; Engine owns quotes, reservation, RNG, time, single durable publication and UI/save binding.
candidate_packet_seam.alternative_and_abstention: A fixed finite authored node plus one repair recipe is cheaper than a general ecosystem. If the selected world does not rely on local resource scarcity, keep current native gathering and omit node depletion.
candidate_packet_seam.cost_and_state: Moderate cross-owner compatibility work. Reuse the existing game clock, native inventory/equipment, simulation command/job state and save envelope. Specify whether a batch is prepaid or must still have a live source/tool at completion; bind RNG state and reserved stock to the same transaction. No numerical performance or savings claim is made.
candidate_packet_seam.acceptance_later: On a generated save, cut or purchase actual stock, craft/repair once, refuse/interupt once, then reload/return. Confirm exact node amount, material identity/condition, inventory, currency, RNG receipt and one output agree; rendering/replay grants nothing. Deferred, not performed here.

coverage.actual_gap_or_no_gap: Local funded work exists and Joss is a positive connected wage/payee example. General independent livelihoods/institutional budgets remain partial. Explicitly distinguish a native player money sink from income: current fees from teaching or a commission do not produce teacher/worker receipts unless an effect credits that actor. coverage.selected_vs_optional_need: Required only for campaigns that depend on wage employment, household/worksite rights, funded public service, private livelihood or institutional enforcement. A self-funded one-time local commission can stay simple when these dimensions do not change choices.

candidate_packet_seam.example: Offer a resident a one-shift paid fitting job. The player can accept only after seeing the named payer's available purse, agreed output/recipient, fee/wage and site slot; decline leaves the resident's own smaller plan available. Completion transfers the actual made fitting and wages once. A teacher's lesson can remain tuition as a sink or be explicit income, but the player-facing terms must state which.
candidate_packet_seam.reuse: Bases owns institution/right/budget terms; Society authors payer/payee, trust, refusal and independent alternatives; Items/Regions own actual goods/demand; Engine binds command/job participants, current wallet/stock quote, UI and atomic save publication.
candidate_packet_seam.alternative_and_abstention: One named payer, one finite accepted order and one decline/default behavior is enough. Do not add general accounting, law, guild rank or simulated markets when a local one-off contract suffices.
candidate_packet_seam.cost_and_state: Moderate for a frozen single shift; higher for continuing rent, wages, upkeep or delegated operation. Requires explicit old-save rule (missing purse/contract gives no retroactive salary), due-time policy, payer/payee owner, exact stock and cancellation/refund terms. Reuse played time and current balances; closed-browser advancement remains unselected.
candidate_packet_seam.acceptance_later: Generated-save positive and decline/unanswered routes; confirm real payer balance, worker income, goods owner, due time, capacity, refusal alternative, cancellation and one-time reload/return. Injected failed write and human review are deferred.
